rounds.text: Cosco (India) Ltd carries a valuation and risk profile that the underlying fundamental evidence does not support, primarily driven by a stark contrast between its stellar recent profitability and its dismal historical performance [E24, E26]. While the headline return on equity of 28.0% looks appealing [E13], the business is weighed down by a 5-year median return on equity of -15% and a 3-year median return on equity of just 5% [E24, E25]. This dramatic cyclicality or instability makes the current trailing P/E of 34.9x [E1] and a demanding price-to-book ratio of 6.46x [E2] difficult to justify for a company with a modest ROCE of only 7.5% [E12]. Furthermore, investors receive zero income for taking on these risks, as evidenced by a dividend yield of 0.00% [E4]. The stock's heavy discount relative to its 52-week high, sitting only 28% of the way up its range [E5], signals persistent market skepticism that aligns with these underlying structural weaknesses. Conceded: [E6].
